title: A Noble Gangster
question: How did Hawkwood make money in times of peace?

meanings.usage: 指参与有组织犯罪的人，常带有暴力性质

meanings.meaning: 保护，防护；（黑社会索要的）保护费
meanings.usage: 既可指普通的保护行为，也可指黑帮名义上提供“保护”实则勒索的费用
强调动作发生得准时、没有延迟
指彻底损坏某物，使其无法使用或恢复
指违反法律、应受到惩罚的行为

meanings.meaning: 非凡的，引人注目的，出色的
meanings.usage: 用来形容人或事物不同寻常、值得注意
表示在某地长期居住，也可指处理、解决问题或纠纷
用于形容人在危险或困难情境下表现出的勇气，带有褒义

meanings.meaning: 显著的，著名的，值得注意的
meanings.usage: 指人或事物因成就、特点等被广泛知晓
常用搭配dedicate sth to sb/sth，表示将某物用于特定目的或献给某人

phrases.usage: 表示“作为对……的回报/交换”，后接名词或动名词，引出交换的对象

examples.en: I bought him a drink in return for his help.
examples.zh: 我给他买了一杯饮料，作为对他帮助的回报。

examples.en: The workers get salary in return for their daily work.
examples.zh: 工人们获得薪水，作为日常工作的报酬。

phrases.usage: 表示“使某人停业，迫使某人破产”，指让企业或商家无法继续经营

examples.en: The big supermarket put many small shops out of business last year.
examples.zh: 去年这家大型超市迫使很多小商店停业了。

examples.en: The serious fire almost put the factory out of business.
examples.zh: 那场严重的火灾几乎让这家工厂破产。

phrases.usage: 表示“出名，成名”，指通过自身努力获得名声、知名度

examples.en: She made a name for herself as a talented singer at a young age.
examples.zh: 她年轻时就作为一名有天赋的歌手成名了。

examples.en: The designer made a name for himself with his unique style.
examples.zh: 这位设计师凭借其独特的风格出了名。

phrases.usage: 表示“与……处于交战状态”，主语常为国家、城邦等政权主体

examples.en: The two countries were at war with each other for three years.
examples.zh: 这两个国家彼此交战了三年。

examples.en: The kingdom was at war with its neighbor for control of the island.
examples.zh: 这个王国为了争夺岛屿的控制权与邻国交战。

phrases.usage: 表示“尽管，不管”，后接名词、代词或动名词，引导让步关系，相当于despite

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he still went to work on time.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨，他还是准时去上班了。

examples.en: They kept climbing the mountain in spite of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，他们还是继续登山。

phrases.usage: 表示“为纪念……”，常用于艺术作品、纪念碑等，表达对逝者的纪念

examples.en: This book is dedicated to the memory of my grandfather.
examples.zh: 这本书是为了纪念我的祖父而写的。

examples.en: The monument was dedicated to the memory of the soldiers who died in the war.
examples.zh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵而建的。

sentences.en: There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for 'protection'.
sentences.zh: 过去，芝加哥的店主和商人们不得不向歹徒支付大笔金钱，以换取“保护”。

sentences.en: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
sentences.zh: 如果不及时付款，歹徒就会捣毁店主的店铺，使其很快破产。

sentences.en: Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.
sentences.zh: 敲诈“保护费”并非是现代社会的罪行。

sentences.en: As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
sentences.zh: 远在14世纪，英国人约翰·霍克伍德爵士就有了惊人的发现，人们情愿支付大笔金钱，也不愿自己的毕生心血毁于歹徒之手。

sentences.en: Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.
sentences.zh: 600年前，约翰·霍克伍德爵士率领一队士兵抵达意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近定居下来。

sentences.en: He soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto.
sentences.zh: 他很快就出了名，意大利人称他为乔瓦尼·阿库托。

sentences.en: Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other, Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
sentences.zh: 无论意大利城邦之间何时交战，霍克伍德总是将他的士兵雇佣给那些愿意支付他所要求的高价的君主。

sentences.en: In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state, and after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away if protection money was paid to them.
sentences.zh: 在和平时期，当生意不好时，霍克伍德和他的手下就会开进一个城邦，烧毁几座农场后，提出如果向他们支付保护费，他们就离开。

sentences.en: Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way.
sentences.zh: 霍克伍德就是这样赚取了大笔金钱。

sentences.en: In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，意大利人还是把他看作一个英雄。

sentences.en: When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue'.
sentences.zh: 他80岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬，并绘制了一幅纪念他的画像，画像上写着：“最英勇的士兵和最杰出的领袖，乔瓦尼·霍克伍德先生”。

exercises.prompt: “非凡的，引人注目的，出色的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: remarkable · /rɪˈmɑːkəbl/ · adjective · 非凡的，引人注目的，出色的。用来形容人或事物不同寻常、值得注意

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：及时地，迅速地，立即地
exercises.explain: promptly · /ˈprɒmptli/ · adverb · 及时地，迅速地，立即地。强调动作发生得准时、没有延迟

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：The workers get salary _____ their daily work.
exercises.hint: 工人们获得薪水，作为日常工作的报酬。
exercises.explain: in return for：表示“作为对……的回报/交换”，后接名词或动名词，引出交换的对象（工人们获得薪水，作为日常工作的报酬。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work _____ by gangsters.
exercises.hint: 远在14世纪，英国人约翰·霍克伍德爵士就有了惊人的发现，人们情愿支付大笔金钱，也不愿自己的毕生心血毁于歹徒之手。
exercises.explain: As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters. — 远在14世纪，英国人约翰·霍克伍德爵士就有了惊人的发现，人们情愿支付大笔金钱，也不愿自己的毕生心血毁于歹徒之手。

source.en: As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.

exercises.prompt: “表达“宁愿做……而不愿做……”的选择偏好，强调在两个选项中更倾向于前者” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + would rather + 动词原形 + than + 动词原形
options: 动词不定式作表语 (Infinitive as Predicative)
exercises.explain: would rather ... than ... 结构：主语 + would rather + 动词原形 + than + 动词原形：用于表示主观上的选择，than前后的动词形式要保持一致，否定形式为would rather not do sth

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.
options: 霍克伍德就是这样赚取了大笔金钱。
我们在一个小镇上呆了几天，参观了附近的一些古老的教堂。
船上许多游客已和小贩们讨价还价起来，
600年前，约翰·霍克伍德爵士率领一队士兵抵达意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近定居下来。
exercises.explain: Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence. — 600年前，约翰·霍克伍德爵士率领一队士兵抵达意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近定居下来。

source.en: Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.

grammar.title: would rather ... than ... 结构
grammar.definition: 表达“宁愿做……而不愿做……”的选择偏好，强调在两个选项中更倾向于前者
grammar.structure: 主语 + would rather + 动词原形 + than + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于表示主观上的选择，than前后的动词形式要保持一致，否定形式为would rather not do sth

examples.en: People would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
examples.zh: 人们宁愿支付大笔钱财，也不愿自己毕生的事业被歹徒毁掉。

examples.en: I would rather stay at home reading than go to the noisy party.
examples.zh: 我宁愿待在家看书，也不愿去那个吵闹的派对。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句：There was a time when ...
grammar.definition: 表示“曾经有一段时间……”，用于描述过去某段时间内经常发生的情况或存在的状态
grammar.structure: There was a time + when引导的定语从句，when在从句中作时间状语
grammar.usage: 用来引出过去的特定时期的情况，when引导的从句通常用一般过去时

examples.en: There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for 'protection'.
examples.zh: 曾经有一段时间，芝加哥的店主和商人不得不向歹徒支付大笔钱财以换取“保护”。

examples.en: There was a time when I lived in the countryside and played with my friends every day.
examples.zh: 曾经有一段时间我住在乡下，每天都和朋友们一起玩耍。

patterns.pattern: If + 一般过去时的条件从句, 主语 + would + 动词原形

original.en: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
original.zh: 如果钱没有及时支付，歹徒们就会捣毁他的店铺，很快让他破产。

examples.en: If I got the ticket, I would go to the concert with you.
examples.zh: 如果我拿到票的话，我就会和你一起去听音乐会。

examples.en: If he practiced more, he would pass the driving test easily.
examples.zh: 如果他多练习的话，他就能轻松通过驾照考试。

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主语 + 主句动作

original.en: When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue'.
original.zh: 当他80岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬，还为他画了一幅画像，以纪念这位“最英勇的战士和最杰出的领袖，乔瓦尼·奥库多先生”。

examples.en: When the old professor retired, the school held a grand party and gave him a medal in honor of his 40 years of teaching.
examples.zh: 当这位老教授退休时，学校举办了一场盛大的聚会，还给他颁发了一枚奖章，以表彰他40年的教学工作。

examples.en: When the team won the championship, the fans cheered loudly and held a parade through the city to celebrate the victory.
examples.zh: 当这支队伍赢得冠军时，球迷们大声欢呼，还在城市里举行了游行来庆祝胜利。
